bio.text: Melanie Ross Levin has represented the 10th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2024.
Ross Levin was previously Director of Delaware's State Office of Women's Advancement and Advocacy, and before that Director of Engagement and Mobilization at the National Women's Law Center.
Ross Levin holds a master's degree in public administration and a bachelor's degree in political science and women's studies from the University of Delaware, and lives in North Wilmington.
